source.source_text: 1974: Born in Los Angeles, California | 1991: Debut in Critters 3 | 1993: Played Tobias Wolff in 'This Boy's Life' | 1993: Received critical acclaim and first Academy Award nomination for 'What's Eating Gilbert Grape' | 1993: Won National Board of Review Award | 1995: Star in The Quick and the Dead | 1996: Star in Romeo + Juliet | 1997: International stardom with Titanic. | 1997: Star in Titanic | 1998: Brief featured role in Woody Allen's Celebrity | 1998: Established the Leonardo DiCaprio Foundation in 1998. | 1999: Won a Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Screen Couple | 2000: Debut in Titanic | 2002: Received third Golden Globe nomination for performance in Catch Me If You Can

generation.adaptation: Garder une trajectoire d'acteur mondial, mais orienter davantage vers engagement climatique et carrière européenne

best_attempt.candidate_narrative: 1981: Born in Los Angeles, California | 1997: Joined European theater in 'The Merchant of Venice' | 1999: Won the Molière Award for 'The Taming of the Shrew' | 2000: Starred in 'Titanic', leading to global fame | 2002: Received third César nomination for 'Catch Me If You Can' | 2003: Founded the Leonardo DiCaprio Foundation to promote environmental causes | 2004: Featured in 'Blood Diamond', highlighting human rights issues | 2005: Began to focus more on climate change advocacy | 2008: Received a BAFTA nomination for 'Revolutionary Road'
best_attempt.rationale: Maintains global trajectory with increased focus on climate advocacy and European engagements.
